base_value_source: 01_historical-financials.md §1, footnote 1 (FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA €903.0m, management-stated on the FY2025 Earnings Call, Mar 26 2026, cross-checked to the Capital IQ Estimates workbook EBITDA actual line)

sensitivities.label: FY2026 GMV like-for-like growth
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient pairs two ranges management disclosed together as FY2026 guidance (GMV LFL 8%-10% and Adjusted EBITDA €910m-€960m) but does not itself state a formal 1:1 linkage - the linkage is this agent's inference. A break below 8% (a demand shock) is untested by the guided range and could convert at a steeper marginal EBITDA hit via fixed-cost deleverage than this linear scale implies.

sensitivities.label: Delivery-expense cost-of-sales ratio (rider/logistics cost, % of revenue)
sensitivities.non_linearity: No disclosed contractual pass-through mechanism for rider-cost inflation - cost increases flow straight to margin with no demonstrated offsetting price lever. A reclassification event (e.g. Italy following Spain) could be a discrete step-change rather than a gradual ratio move, and carries a separate disclosed contingent liability of EUR440m-EUR770m in Spain alone, not captured by this linear per-pp scale.
sensitivities.source: 03_margin-drivers.md §2, §8 (FY24 Annual Report, Note 15/2 'Cost of Sales,' p.109; Note H.5 'Contingencies - Rider Status,' p.203-204)

sensitivities.label: USD/EUR FX move (monetary/transaction exposure)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Disclosed figure covers only monetary/transaction exposure, not full income-statement translation of the ~85% of Group revenue earned outside the eurozone (inference on the translation scale, not from filings) - actual earnings sensitivity to USD/EUR is likely larger than this coefficient implies.
sensitivities.source: business-model/10_external-dependency.md §2 (FY24 Annual Report, Note H.3.b 'Sensitivity Analysis of Foreign Exchange Rate Changes,' p.201 - 10% USD/EUR move = +/-EUR26.8m P&L effect, Dec-31-2024)

sensitivities.label: KRW/EUR FX move (monetary/transaction exposure)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Same translation-exposure caveat as USD/EUR. KRW exposure is concentrated in the Asia segment, currently in a competitive/margin recovery (see asia_segment_ebitda_margin_pp) - a KRW depreciation coinciding with a Korea-driven Asia margin improvement would partly offset in euro-reported terms.
sensitivities.source: business-model/10_external-dependency.md §2 (FY24 Annual Report, Note H.3.b, p.201 - 10% KRW/EUR move = +/-EUR72.0m P&L effect, Dec-31-2024)

sensitivities.label: Asia segment Adjusted EBITDA margin (competitive intensity, Korea/Southeast Asia)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Asia's FY2025 margin decline was driven by a discrete competitive event (a new entrant's Sept-2024 market entry in Korea) and a ~2-year platform rebuild, not a smooth continuous variable - the same magnitude move in either direction is not guaranteed to be linear beyond the +/-192bps range already observed.
sensitivities.source: 03_margin-drivers.md §6, §7a-ii (Asia segment margin -192bps FY2025 vs FY2024; segment revenue EUR4,418.6m, CIQ Segments tab); FY24 Annual Report p.4, p.105-106

sensitivities.label: Integrated Verticals (Dmarts) Adjusted EBITDA margin
sensitivities.non_linearity: Segment swung +373bps in a single year off a near-zero base - management guides only to 'slight positive EBITDA' while continuing to reinvest, so further large positive moves are capped near-term by the company's own stated reinvestment intent; a reversal toward negative margin is not bounded by the same cap.
sensitivities.source: 03_margin-drivers.md §6, §7a-ii (Integrated Verticals margin-rate effect EUR119.0m on EUR3,189.0m FY2025 segment revenue, +373bps FY2025 vs FY2024)
